_doc: Blender asset builds re-verified by tools/dev/verify_blender_builds.py (M1-QA-02, ADR 0005). See docs/kb/qa/blender_builds.md.
_threads: M1-QA-06: Blender runs with --threads <n>, never the host's CPU count. A job that exports tangents runs single-threaded: Blender's threaded tangent export races (base_body differed run to run at 4 threads, and was stable at 1). Vegetation stopped exporting them (M1-ENV-07), so it is back at the default. Every other job is pinned at 4, the count its committed files were built with (Asha's body bakes change with the thread count). Verified on a 4-vCPU host only (M1-NIT-01). See docs/kb/qa/blender_builds.md.
